claims.text: The experiments utilized parallel corpora from the multilingual Indian Language Corpora Initiative (ILCI) and the OpenSubtitles2016 section of the OPUS corpus collection.
The training sets included various representation units and were evaluated using word-level BLEU and LeBLEU metrics.
The experiments involved 16 language pairs, 17 languages, and 10 writing systems, indicating a diverse dataset.
